title: Jim Lacatski of the DIA, part of AAWSAP, writing about the program

tellings.quote: And then the weird thing is you have Jim Lacatski coming out, you know, who is is DIA rocket scientist involved in ASAP and he's now writing about this stuff

plain: Michels points out that Jim Lacatski, a rocket scientist at the DIA, the Pentagon's military intelligence agency, who worked on AAWSAP, a Pentagon-funded study of unexplained aerial phenomena begun in 2008, is now writing publicly about the subject. Michels says this himself and calls it strange, since it would mean a government insider from the study is now speaking openly about it.
